summary: Iteration 2 full-stack validation of kick-off auto-lock + Everyone's tips features. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass (16 regression + 11 new in /app/backend/tests/test_kickoff_and_alltips.py) covering admin PUT /matches/{id} with kickoff/clear_kickoff, invalid kickoff -> 400, non-admin -> 403, future/past kickoff -> locked/started flags, submit_tips returns {saved, skipped} skipping started matches, GET /rounds exposes revealed_count, GET /rounds/{n}/all-tips auth-gated, admin excluded, counts & revealed gating correct, and critically NO leak of un-revealed match tips in player picks. Frontend (390x844 web preview): registered a new player, navigated to Round 13 (with admin-forced past-kickoff on match 0, future on others), confirmed match card displays 'Wed 21 Oct · 1:17 AM · TIPS LOCKED' with lock icon, future match shows 'Locks in 30d', locked match pick buttons are disabled (my_tip remained empty), the 'everyone-tips-button' appeared and navigates to /round-tips/13 where split-card-0 renders with correct counts (2-0) and split-card-1 is correctly hidden; player-by-player table lists all players, shows '(you)' highlight. Admin flow: /admin/round/1 shows admin-match-{i}-kickoff rows; opening modal renders day/hour/min steppers, 'Save kick-off', 'Apply to all', 'Clear' buttons as per spec. All R13 kickoffs were restored to original future values after testing; no finals rounds were added.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still emitted by react-native-web internals. Non-blocking; carry-over from iteration 1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py Match.started() silently treats invalid ISO strings as not-started - acceptable but could log; validation on PUT already blocks invalid input so DB stays clean.
server.py submit_tips re-fetches each match sequentially - fine for 4-8 matches/round but could batch with $in for larger rounds.
/api/rounds/{n}/all-tips excludes admin via users dict filter - this is correct and double-protects since picks dict is keyed by user_id that was filtered.
frontend (tabs)/index.tsx uses useNow() ticker to re-evaluate lock without waiting for refetch - good UX; staleLock effect also forces refetch when kickoff crosses now.
KickoffModal day/hour/min steppers construct Date locally and emit ISO - time zone handling delegated to formatKickoff; verified preview matched Save button payload.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 ephemeral TEST_fe_* player and several TEST_kt_* players via /api/auth/register. No team names modified.
